package.name: cobot_control
package.description: Single cobot node (Python, pybind — NOT a C++ ROS node). cobot_node is the motion execution server: it serves the PickCan and MoveToPose actions (one goal at a time, native cancel) — all decisions and sequencing live in cobot_tasks/task_manager. The Cobot class drives the Motoman through the motoman_cpp pybind extension exactly as the legacy application did.
